groups.title: Shop presses · value line
groups.lead: Hand-pump and motorized workshop presses from 10 to 176 tons, and shop press brakes — NovoTech value line, built in China.

groups.title: Hydraulic presses · value line
groups.lead: Motorized H-frame, brake, sliding-table, C-frame and four-column presses from 22 to 551 US tons — NovoTech value line, built in China.

intro_add: NovoTech's value-line presses, built in China, add hand-pump and motorized shop presses from 10 to 176 tons, motorized H-frame presses to 551 US tons, presses with a brake function, sliding-table, C-frame and four-column presses.
points_add: NovoTech value line: shop presses 10 – 176 t, H-frame presses 33 – 551 US tons, brake, sliding-table, C-frame and four-column presses

faq_add.a: The premium-line shop and production presses are built in Turkey with European hydraulics and Siemens controls, for daily production work, straightening lines and custom sizes. The value-line presses are built in China for the repair shop, the maintenance department and lighter production — the same tonnages at a lower price, with hand pumps on the small presses and built-on or separate power units on the motorized ones.

set.hero_brand_line: Premium-line shop presses are built in Turkey for NovoTech's premium line; the NovoTech premium-line production presses are built in Turkey with European components; the value-line presses are built in China — all to NovoTech's specification and sold, installed and supported in Canada by NovoTech.
